fields.label: Country
fields.note: Listed in the widget's all_fields (city, state, category, type, orgFunction, country); the response is geo-defaulted to India, so the country effect was not isolated.

notes: Cisco's careers entry redirects to the Phenom site careers.cisco.com, whose search-results page POSTs refineSearch to /widgets with all_fields city/state/category/type/orgFunction/country and 500 rows per request. The page URL accepts the same facets: unfiltered totalHits 1448; keywords=engineer returned 757 hits whose rows were all engineer roles; category=Product and Engineering&type=Full time returned 726 hits with every row matching both. No explicit sort control was observed on the page.
